description: This file defines the Statement class for the mysqli driver in Drupal, implementing database statement handling with support for named placeholders, execution, and result fetching.

classes.name: Statement
classes.description: Implements a database statement for mysqli, handling parameter conversion, execution, and result retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Statement object with database connection, query, options, and fetch mode.

methods.name: getClientStatement
methods.description: Returns the mysqli_stmt object representing the prepared statement.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Prepares and executes the SQL statement with given arguments and options, handling parameter conversion and result processing.
